# Go Microservices Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Go

## Overview

Builds microservices in Go with gRPC, protocol buffers, service discovery, and distributed tracing for production-grade systems

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [go-microservices-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
go-microservices-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@go-microservices-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build gRPC services with protobuf definitions
- Implement service discovery with Consul or etcd
- Add distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry
- Configure health checks and readiness probes

## Technology Standards Applied

- **gRPC Go**: Go gRPC implementation patterns
- **OpenTelemetry Go**: Distributed tracing and metrics
- **Protobuf**: Protocol buffer design guidelines
